description: Migrate forge-top narrative→structured (precondition for retiring narrative). One-time standalone script. Foreign-owned (compose/stratum) rows leave the live ROADMAP.md (option C — ROADMAP.md becomes forge-OWNED-only; foreign codes declared via externalPrefixes so validate/roundtrip skip them); the live cross-product view is the roadmap dependency graph (COMP-ROADMAP-GRAPH-3). Owned-here rows get a real feature.json. Curated changelog/Roadmap-Model prose extracted to docs/preserved-sections (never dropped). Order: classify → scaffold owned-here + set externalPrefixes → preserve prose → dry-run checkRoundtrip → flip narrative:false → validate clean. NOT link-carriers (option B dropped: xref-sync reconciles links[].expect not top-level status, so they'd render placeholders). Depends on COMP-ROADMAP-GRAPH-3. Design: docs/features/COMP-ROADMAP-MIGRATE/design.md. ROUND-TRIP SAFETY VERIFIED (2026-09-11, SmartMemory ROADMAP-MIGRATE-1): lib/roadmap-gen.js:56 generateRoadmapFromBase was called directly on a frozen snapshot with the narrative guard (:214, :519) and the CLI residue guard (bin/compose.js:1329) bypassed. The unprotected write went 6,915 -> 6,995 lines: 80 additions, ZERO deletions. It patches base text rather than regenerating, so preservation is structural, not merely guard-enforced. This removes the main data-loss risk from the migration.
